newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: DMC sets conversion price for preferred shr.
newsitem.headline: DMC sets conversion price for preferred shr.

text.p: Construction concern DMCI Holdings Inc said on Wednesday it had set the conversion price of its preferred shares at 21.36 pesos.
In a statement to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company said the conversion price was based on a 15-day market price at 19.42 pesos plus a premium of 10 percent.
DMCI Holdings is currently offering 2.4 million preferred shares at 1,000 pesos each. These are convertible to common shares.
The issue date of the preferred share offer is on April 7 and the stocks will be convertible during the period October 7, 1997 to March 7, 2002.
The company will have to buy back the preferred shares five years after the issue date. It can also redeem the shares starting from the second year.
The proceeds of the offer will be be used to fund the company's various infrastructure projects and acquisitions, it said.
DMCI closed at 18.00 pesos on Wednesday, down 25 centavos. -- Manila newsroom 63 2 841-8937 fax 8176267
